title: The Cold Colony
author: Marguerite Sandoval
blurb: Petra Thackeray, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
